name: atomize-commits
description: Splits tangled changes into separate, well-described commits with Conventional Commits messages.

commitSplitter.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter that can import the splitter package. Use the absolute path to your virtual environment's python if you made one.

commitSplitter.enginePath.description: Absolute path to the engine folder containing the splitter package. Leave blank to search the workspace.

commitSplitter.provider.description: Which model writes the commit messages. 'none' uses structural heuristics and never leaves your machine.

commitSplitter.model.description: Override the provider's default model name.

commitSplitter.useHistory.description: Mine git log for files that habitually change together.

scripts.lint: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/planner.js && node --check src/panel.js
scripts.bundle: rm -rf engine && mkdir -p engine && cp -R ../engine/splitter engine/splitter && find engine -name __pycache__ -type d -exec rm -rf {} +
